question_text: A depot stores references to zero or more bicycles. Each bicycle object can exist before joining a depot and after leaving it. Describe the relationship between Depot and Bicycle classes.
adaptation_rationale: Specify lifetime independence to remove source aggregation/composition ambiguity. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Aggregation: Depot has Bicycle component references, but bicycles have independent lifetimes and are not destroyed when the depot object is removed.

marking_points.criterion: Uses independent lifetime condition to distinguish composition.
